label: TP
reason: Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities. Alert 1 (java/xss): User input flows through param→map49381→bar→fileName and reaches the HTML sink at lines 67-69 via encodeForHTML. While encoding is present, the resolved sink value (fileName) is attacker-controlled per the balanced encoding principle—marking as alert-TP. Alert 2 (java/path-injection): Same data flow shows fileName at line 62 depends on user input, creating potential path traversal risk. Neither alert qualifies as FP since the resolved sink values remain attacker-controlled.
